title: 河床固床工設計~Riverbed grade-control structures
focus: 由河床縱坡、能量耗散與泥砂連續性設計固床工~Designing grade control through bed slope, energy dissipation and sediment continuity
summary: 固床工會改變水面、河床及泥砂通量，並非把河床固定後便完成任務。十個單元連結落差配置、臨界水深、水躍、揚壓、顆粒起動、濾層與上下游地形反應，讓學員分辨幾何可行、結構穩定與河道長期平衡三種不同檢核。~Grade control changes water levels, bed elevations and sediment fluxes. Ten units connect drop spacing, critical depth, hydraulic jumps, uplift, grain motion, filters and channel response. Learners distinguish geometric feasibility, structural resistance and long term channel adjustment, and examine how protecting one location may transfer erosion or sedimentation to another reach.
history: 美國自然資源保育署二〇〇七年固床技術補編同時討論水理、沖刷與河道反應，案例包括伊利諾州藍溪的一九九七與二〇〇二年縱斷面，以及曼尼托巴省明克溪的塊石構造。這些圖說年份是調查資料年代，不等同施工或完工年代。另以工程兵團泥砂手冊釐清希爾茲參數的定義，避免把任一輸砂公式的臨界值套用到所有河床。~The 2007 NRCS grade stabilization supplement considers hydraulics, scour and channel response. Its examples include Blue Creek profiles dated 1997 and 2002 and a loose rock structure at Mink Creek in Manitoba. Profile dates identify survey evidence rather than construction or completion. The Corps sediment reference provides the Shields definition and explains why critical parameters must correspond to the chosen transport formulation. The lesson uses original numerical examples rather than reproducing case design values.
example: 本課先用「落差配置與縱坡」建立原創假想基準，再以「斷面比能的兩種流態」檢查另一個控制機制。第一組輸入及結果為 dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m；第二組為 y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m。學員需在同一張工作表分列量綱、時間、位置與適用範圍，先核對守恆，再解釋為何兩個得數不能互相代替。最後以第三單元提出的量測設計驗證假設，並將超出模型能力的水理、生態或治理問題列為待研究項目；這些示例並非所列案例的現場實測。敏感度重算：固定兩個無因次坡度 S0=0.012 與 Se=0.004，將單一落差 dz 從 0.6 m 增至 0.66 m，L=82.5 m，相較 75 m 增加一成。此為幾何敏感度，沒有驗證較大落差的消能、通行或結構需求。~Begin with an original hypothetical baseline for Drop spacing and longitudinal slope and examine another controlling mechanism through Specific energy and alternate depths. The first inputs and result are dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m; the second are y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m. Keep dimensions, time, location and validity conditions in separate columns of the same working sheet. Check conservation before explaining why the two numerical results cannot substitute for one another. Use the third unit measurement design to test assumptions and identify hydraulic, ecological or governance questions that exceed the model. These examples are not field observations from the named reference cases. Sensitivity recalculation: Hold dimensionless slopes S0=0.012 and Se=0.004 fixed and raise drop dz from 0.6 m to 0.66 m. Spacing becomes 82.5 m, ten percent above 75 m. This is geometric sensitivity and does not validate energy dissipation, passage or structural requirements at the larger drop.

units.anchor: 落差配置與縱坡~Drop spacing and longitudinal slope
units.title: 落差配置與縱坡~Drop spacing and longitudinal slope
units.mechanism: 固床工把河段總落差分配到構造物與其間河床，先用幾何關係可以檢查配置是否自洽。原坡與目標坡的差值乘以間距，才是單一落差需要承擔的高程差，並非河段全部天然落差。目標坡還受輸砂、河寬與下游控制影響，不能僅為縮短施工量而任意選定。配置圖須同時標出支流匯入、橋梁與魚類通行位置，因為相同總落差的不同分配會產生不同局部影響。~Grade control distributes total reach fall between structures and intervening bed. A geometric balance checks consistency: the difference between existing and target slope, multiplied by spacing, gives the drop assigned to one structure. Target slope also depends on sediment supply, width and downstream control, so it cannot be chosen solely to reduce construction. Map tributaries, bridges and passage routes because different distributions of identical total fall create different local consequences.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m。適用邊界：均一坡度的幾何初估，不是最適間距或平衡坡保證。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m. Applicable boundary: Geometric screening with uniform slopes, not an optimal spacing or guarantee of equilibrium.
units.verify: 以同一高程基準重測河床縱斷面，分辨局部沙洲頂與深槽底，核對相鄰構造物之間的總落差。將支流出口與洪水水面另畫，若存在回水控制，應進行水面與泥砂分析後再修正幾何配置。~Resurvey the bed profile on one datum, distinguishing bar crests from the thalweg, and check total fall between structures. Plot tributary outlets and flood levels separately; backwater control requires hydraulic and sediment analysis before adopting geometric spacing.
units.failure: 間距雖符合幾何式，若下游河床持續下降，末端構造仍可能被淘空並引發逐級失效。診斷應從下游控制與供砂變化回查，而非只補高上游堰頂。~Geometrically consistent spacing can still fail when downstream incision undermines the terminal structure and progresses upstream. Investigate downstream control and sediment supply before simply raising upstream crests to restore the profile.
units.misconception: 由坡差算出的間距就是所有流量下的最適構造物間距~Spacing derived from slope difference is optimal at every discharge
units.practice: 將目標坡改成千分之六重算間距，說明為何落差較少分配給河床時構造密度會改變。畫出末端下切時的可能傳遞路徑，列出必要調查點。~Set target slope to six per thousand and recompute spacing. Explain the changed distribution of fall, then sketch how terminal incision could propagate and identify the survey points needed to test that sequence.

units.anchor: 斷面比能的兩種流態~Specific energy and alternate depths
units.title: 斷面比能的兩種流態~Specific energy and alternate depths
units.mechanism: 比能以局部河床為基準，把水深與速度水頭合在一起，適合辨認落差上游是否接近控制斷面。矩形河道的單寬流量固定時，同一比能可能對應深慢與淺快兩種水深解；臨界點則是比能最低位置。這裡所稱兩種解不是可任意互換的現場狀態，還要符合上下游邊界和能量損失。河床高程若改變，總水頭必須另加高程，不能直接比較不同斷面的比能數字。~Specific energy combines depth and velocity head relative to the local bed. At fixed unit discharge in a rectangular channel, one energy level can correspond to a deep slow or shallow fast depth, while the minimum defines critical flow. These alternate depths are not freely interchangeable field states; boundary conditions and losses select the actual solution. When bed elevation changes, include elevation in total head rather than comparing specific energy values from different sections directly.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m。適用邊界：矩形斷面、速度分布係數取一且近似靜水壓，未包含局部損失。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m. Applicable boundary: Rectangular section with unit velocity correction and approximately hydrostatic pressure, excluding local losses.
units.verify: 量水深與斷面流量後以多點速度確認分布是否均勻，再將實測點放在比能曲線上。不同測站需加回各自床高才能比較總水頭，若發現表面落差卻無對應能損，先核對基準與量測位置。~Measure depth and discharge, check velocity distribution at several points, and place observations on a specific-energy curve. Add bed elevation at each station before comparing total head. Apparent inconsistencies require checks of datum and measurement location before interpreting losses.
units.failure: 在強烈垂直加速度的跌水口直接使用靜水壓比能，可能錯估控制水深。應移到壓力分布較合理的斷面，或改用能描述非靜水效應的模型。~Applying a hydrostatic expression within a rapidly curving nappe can misrepresent control depth. Move the section to a suitable location or use a model resolving nonhydrostatic pressure and vertical acceleration.
units.misconception: 不同床高斷面的比能可直接相減當作全部水頭損失~Specific energies at different bed elevations directly give total head loss
units.practice: 保持單寬流量不變，另算一個較深水深的比能並畫在曲線上。把兩斷面床高也列入帳表，說明哪些組合需要能量輸入才可能成立。~Keep unit discharge fixed and calculate specific energy at a greater depth. Plot both points and add bed elevations in a head ledger, explaining which combinations would require an external energy input.

units.anchor: 臨界水深與控制斷面~Critical depth and control sections
units.title: 臨界水深與控制斷面~Critical depth and control sections
units.mechanism: 在矩形斷面中，比能對水深的斜率為零可導出臨界水深，對應水流傳播速度與重力波速的關係。它提供流態分界，但不代表構造物每個位置都會自動達到臨界。寬頂、收縮與下游淹沒情況會決定控制是否存在；若下游水位足夠高，原先假設的自由控制可能被淹沒。解題應先畫水面與床面，再判斷控制位置，最後才帶入單寬流量計算。~Critical depth follows from the minimum of specific energy in a rectangular section and relates flow speed to gravity-wave propagation. It marks a regime boundary, not a state that every point near a structure automatically reaches. Crest length, contraction and downstream submergence determine whether a control exists. High tailwater can drown a presumed free control. Draw bed and water surfaces, identify a defensible control location, and only then apply unit discharge.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; yc=(q^2/g)^(1/3)=0.837371 m。適用邊界：矩形斷面之臨界水深，不能直接套用梯形斷面或淹沒控制。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; yc=(q^2/g)^(1/3)=0.837371 m. Applicable boundary: Critical depth for a rectangular section, not directly transferable to trapezoidal sections or drowned controls.
units.verify: 在模型槽逐步調整尾水，觀察堰頂附近水深是否保持近似不變。同步量測上下游水位與流量，若尾水改變已影響控制區，就應標記淹沒轉換，不再使用單一自由出流假設外推全部工況。~Raise tailwater progressively in a flume and observe whether crest-region depth remains approximately stable. Record both water levels and discharge. Once tailwater influences the control region, identify the submergence transition instead of extrapolating a free-flow assumption.
units.failure: 忽略尾水淹沒會高估控制能力，並可能誤判上游壅水。若洪峰時水面連續跨越構造，應檢查淹沒而非只懷疑流量儀器失準。~Ignoring submergence can exaggerate control capacity and misrepresent upstream backwater. A continuous flood water surface across the structure warrants checking drowning before assuming that discharge instrumentation has failed.
units.misconception: 臨界水深只由單寬流量決定所以尾水永遠不影響構造出流~Because critical depth depends on unit discharge, tailwater never affects structure discharge
units.practice: 將單寬流量增加一倍重算臨界水深，與水深也增加一倍的直覺比較。補畫自由與淹沒兩種尾水情境，指出公式仍有效與失去控制意義的位置。~Double unit discharge and compare the calculated critical depth with a doubled-depth guess. Sketch free and submerged tailwater conditions and identify where the formula remains valid but no longer defines an actual control.

units.anchor: 水躍共軛水深~Conjugate depths of a hydraulic jump
units.title: 水躍共軛水深~Conjugate depths of a hydraulic jump
units.mechanism: 固床下游的急流可能透過水躍轉成緩流，過程中動量關係可求前後共軛水深，但機械能會耗散。公式假設短距離、矩形斷面與近似水平底床，不能把結果當成消能池長度或護坦厚度。尾水太低時水躍可能向下游移出保護區，太高則呈不同淹沒狀態。設計檢查須同時追蹤流量與尾水組合，並留意脈動壓力對接縫與塊石的反覆作用。~A hydraulic jump can convert supercritical flow below grade control into subcritical flow. Momentum gives conjugate depths while mechanical energy dissipates. The standard relation assumes a short, horizontal, rectangular reach and does not determine basin length or apron thickness. Low tailwater may sweep the jump beyond protection; higher tailwater changes submergence. Examine combinations of discharge and tailwater, including fluctuating pressures acting repeatedly on joints and loose stones, rather than checking one nominal operating point.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：y1=0.4 m; v1=5 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; y2=0.5*y1*(sqrt(1+8*v1^2/(g*y1))-1)=1.241782 m。適用邊界：水平矩形短水躍，未給消能池長度且忽略外加阻力。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: y1=0.4 m; v1=5 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; y2=0.5*y1*(sqrt(1+8*v1^2/(g*y1))-1)=1.241782 m. Applicable boundary: Short hydraulic jump in a horizontal rectangular reach, without basin length or external resisting forces.
units.verify: 同時量測水躍前深度、速度與尾水，錄影追蹤滾流區前緣的位置及振盪範圍。以動量計算和實測後水深比較，若偏差大先查坡度、側壁與阻力影響，再決定是否需實體水工模型。~Measure approach depth, velocity and tailwater together, and film the jump front and its oscillation range. Compare momentum prediction with downstream depth. Large differences require checking bed slope, sidewalls and resistance before considering a physical hydraulic model.
units.failure: 若尾水不足使水躍跳出護坦，計算得到正確共軛水深仍無法保護裸露河床。下游集中沖坑與水躍前緣移動是比平均水深更直接的警訊。~Correct conjugate-depth arithmetic does not protect an exposed bed when inadequate tailwater moves the jump beyond the apron. A concentrated scour hole and migrating jump front provide more direct warning than mean depth.
units.misconception: 共軛水深算正確就同時證明消能池長度足夠~A correct conjugate-depth calculation also proves that the stilling basin is long enough
units.practice: 保持急流水深不變將速度降低一成重算，並比較兩種尾水高度。畫出水躍可能離開護坦的情況，列出除了水深外還應觀測的三項量。~Reduce approach velocity by ten percent at fixed depth and recalculate. Compare two tailwater levels, sketch a jump leaving the apron, and list three observations needed in addition to water depth.

units.anchor: 護坦揚壓與排水~Apron uplift and drainage
units.title: 護坦揚壓與排水~Apron uplift and drainage
units.mechanism: 水可能從構造上游滲到護坦下方，形成向上的孔隙水壓；下游水深增加時，上表面也會受到水壓，必須用淨值比較。沿底板線性下降的壓力分布只是可檢核的簡化假設，接縫漏水、排水失效與地層不均會改變形狀。總揚力由壓力積分取得，接著還要檢查偏心力矩與局部裂縫。單純增加重量可能轉移地基問題，因此排水與截水的效果應以孔壓量測驗證。~Seepage can press upward beneath an apron, while tailwater also loads its upper surface; resistance must be compared with net pressure. A linear underside pressure distribution is a checkable simplification that joints, blocked drains and heterogeneous strata may invalidate. Integrating pressure gives total uplift, after which moments and local cracking still need evaluation. Adding weight can transfer problems to the foundation, so verify drainage and cutoffs through measured pore pressures rather than assumed effectiveness.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：pu=30 kPa; pd=10 kPa; B=4 m; L=6 m; U=0.5*(pu+pd)*B*L=480 kN。適用邊界：給定的是板底淨向上壓力且沿長度線性變化，未檢查板彎曲。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: pu=30 kPa; pd=10 kPa; B=4 m; L=6 m; U=0.5*(pu+pd)*B*L=480 kN. Applicable boundary: Specified values are net upward pressures varying linearly along length; slab bending is not checked.
units.verify: 在底板上游、中部與下游設壓力點，與上表面水深同步比較，確認採用的是淨壓力。檢查排水出口通暢及流量變化，若中部壓力高於線性假設，應修正積分分布並檢查接縫漏水。~Measure pressure beneath the upstream, middle and downstream slab and compare simultaneously with water above it. Confirm net pressure and inspect drain flow. A middle pressure exceeding the assumed line requires revising the integrated distribution and checking joints.
units.failure: 排水堵塞可能使揚壓升高而外觀毫無異常，先出現的接縫張開又會讓更多水進入。應把孔壓上升與裂縫變化連續比對，防止誤當正常水位波動。~Blocked drainage may raise uplift without visible surface damage. Opening joints can then admit more water, so compare pressure increases with crack changes rather than dismissing them as ordinary stage fluctuations.
units.misconception: 護坦下方有排水孔就可以在所有工況忽略揚壓~Drain holes beneath an apron allow uplift to be ignored in every condition
units.practice: 假設下游淨壓力增加一倍而上游不變，重算揚力並比較作用位置。提出至少兩個能區分排水堵塞與河水位上升的量測組合。~Double downstream net pressure while keeping upstream pressure fixed. Recalculate uplift and compare its location, then propose at least two measurement combinations that distinguish blocked drainage from a rise in river stage.

units.anchor: 顆粒起動與希爾茲參數~Grain motion and Shields parameter
units.title: 顆粒起動與希爾茲參數~Grain motion and Shields parameter
units.mechanism: 非黏性床料的起動可用水流剪力相對於顆粒浸水重量尺度來表示，形成無因次希爾茲參數。粒徑代表方式、顆粒排列、隱蔽效應與流況會影響臨界判斷，不能把任何單一數字稱為所有材料的法定安全界線。起動也不等同整個河段的輸砂量，少量細粒先動可能改變裝甲層。解題應先說明床料是否非黏性，再選與輸砂關係相容的臨界描述。~For noncohesive sediment, Shields stress compares fluid shear with a submerged grain-weight scale. Grain-size representation, packing, hiding and flow conditions affect the threshold, so no single number is a universal statutory limit for every bed material. Incipient movement also differs from reach sediment transport; early removal of fines may alter armouring. Identify whether the bed is noncohesive and choose a threshold description consistent with the transport relation before interpreting the dimensionless result.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：tau=40 Pa; rhos=2650 kg/m3; rhow=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; d=0.05 m; theta=tau/((rhos-rhow)*g*d)=0.0494239 dimensionless。適用邊界：只計非黏性顆粒之無因次應力，沒有指定通用起動門檻。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: tau=40 Pa; rhos=2650 kg/m3; rhow=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; d=0.05 m; theta=tau/((rhos-rhow)*g*d)=0.0494239 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Calculates dimensionless stress for noncohesive grains without specifying a universal entrainment threshold.
units.verify: 採集表層與次表層粒徑分布，量測坡度和水深後說明剪力估算方法。用標記顆粒或短時攝影追蹤起動，並記錄先動粒徑；若床料含黏土或根系，須另評估其凝聚與補強效應。~Sample surface and subsurface grain distributions, then document the stress estimate from slope and depth. Track first movement with marked grains or short video sequences and record moving sizes. Clay or roots require separate cohesion or reinforcement assessment.
units.failure: 把混合粒徑河床用單一平均粒徑處理，可能漏掉細料淘洗與粗料失去支承。若表面粗化卻下方出現空洞，應查分選與內部流失而非只看粗粒未移動。~A single mean size can conceal fine-material removal and loss of support beneath coarse grains. Surface coarsening with subsurface voids calls for checking sorting and internal loss, even if large particles remain stationary.
units.misconception: 同一個希爾茲臨界值適用所有粒徑混合與黏性河床~One critical Shields value applies to every grain mixture and cohesive riverbed
units.practice: 將粒徑減半而剪力不變重算參數，說明數值變化為何仍不足以求出輸砂量。列出建立輸砂關係前需要補齊的床料與流況資料。~Halve grain diameter at fixed stress and recalculate. Explain why the changed parameter still does not supply transport rate, and list the sediment and flow information needed before selecting a transport relationship.

units.anchor: 濾層粒徑的相容比較~Filter grading compatibility
units.title: 濾層粒徑的相容比較~Filter grading compatibility
units.mechanism: 護坦或塊石下的濾層需要讓水通過，同時限制細土被帶出，保土與透水是兩個相互牽制的功能。粒徑分位數比值可以協助比較級配，但選用哪一種準則仍取決於土質、流向、分散性與設施規範。單一比值不能驗證厚度、離析或施工破損。檢查應連結基土和濾料的完整級配曲線，再用代表水力梯度的試驗觀察濁度、流量與壓力是否穩定。~A filter beneath stone or concrete must pass water while retaining base soil, creating competing permeability and retention requirements. Ratios of grading percentiles help compare materials, but the applicable criteria depend on soil behaviour, flow direction, dispersivity and project requirements. One ratio does not verify thickness, segregation or construction damage. Compare complete grading curves and use tests at representative hydraulic gradients to observe whether turbidity, discharge and pressure stabilize rather than relying only on sieve labels.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：D15=2 mm; d85=0.5 mm; Rg=D15/d85=4 dimensionless。適用邊界：純級配比值示例，不宣稱四就是任意基土之合格門檻。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: D15=2 mm; d85=0.5 mm; Rg=D15/d85=4 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: A grading ratio example only; four is not asserted as an acceptance threshold for arbitrary soils.
units.verify: 分別取基土與已鋪濾層樣品做篩分，核對分位數皆用相同長度單位。另量施工厚度並檢查離析，必要時在試驗柱施加逐級水頭，觀察出水含砂及壓差，將材料相容與施工品質分開驗證。~Sieve base soil and installed filter samples, keeping percentile sizes in identical units. Check thickness and segregation separately. Where needed, increase head in a test column and monitor discharged sediment and pressure difference to distinguish material compatibility from installation quality.
units.failure: 合格級配在搬運時離析，可能留下過粗透孔區或過細堵塞區。若只查出廠報告而不取現場樣品，會錯把材料證書當成完整濾層性能。~A suitable delivered grading can segregate during handling, leaving open coarse zones or clogged fine zones. Factory certificates without installed samples can therefore misrepresent the performance of the completed filter layer.
units.misconception: 任一濾料與基土的粒徑比等於四就保證濾層安全~Any filter to base-soil grading ratio of four guarantees filter safety
units.practice: 將濾料分位粒徑改成三毫米重算比值，畫出可能離析的兩個區域。說明還需要哪些透水與保土試驗，才能在指定基土下作選材判斷。~Change the filter percentile size to three millimetres and recompute the ratio. Sketch two possible segregation zones and identify permeability and retention tests needed to choose material for the specified base soil.

units.anchor: 河床泥砂收支~Bed sediment continuity
units.title: 河床泥砂收支~Bed sediment continuity
units.mechanism: 固床工限制高程後仍需允許泥砂進出，否則上游淤積與下游缺砂可能同時發生。固體體積通量的差額除以有效河床面積與固體比例，可估平均床高變化；若輸入數據已含孔隙，再除一次固體比例就會重複放大。這個控制體平均值不表示每個位置均勻升降，實際可能集中於沖坑或沙洲。量測計畫應同時追蹤邊界輸砂和內部地形，才能檢查收支閉合。~Grade control must accommodate sediment continuity or upstream deposition and downstream sediment deficit can coexist. Net solid-volume flux divided by bed area and solid fraction estimates mean bed-level change. If input volumes already include pores, another porosity correction double counts the effect. The control-volume average does not imply uniform change at every point; adjustment may concentrate in holes or bars. Monitor both boundary transport and internal topography to test whether the sediment budget closes.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qsi=0.001 m3/s solids; Qso=0.0015 m3/s solids; dt=86400 s; p=0.35 dimensionless; B=12 m; L=80 m; dz=(Qsi-Qso)*dt/((1-p)*B*L)=-0.0692308 m。適用邊界：固體體積通量且無側向輸砂，負值代表控制體平均侵蝕。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qsi=0.001 m3/s solids; Qso=0.0015 m3/s solids; dt=86400 s; p=0.35 dimensionless; B=12 m; L=80 m; dz=(Qsi-Qso)*dt/((1-p)*B*L)=-0.0692308 m. Applicable boundary: Solid-volume transport without lateral sediment exchange; negative change denotes mean control-volume erosion.
units.verify: 比較前後地形時先統一網格與高程基準，再以沉積物密度確認通量是否為固體體積。分列岸崩、支流和清淤量，將地形推算的體積差與邊界通量積分核對，並保留採樣誤差範圍。~Use common survey grids and datums, and confirm whether transport represents solid volume using sediment density. Account separately for bank failure, tributaries and excavation. Compare surveyed volume change with integrated boundary fluxes while retaining sampling uncertainty for both estimates.
units.failure: 忽略岸崩輸入會把實際補砂誤認成量測不準，反之漏算清淤會誇大自然侵蝕。收支不閉合時應逐項查來源，不宜直接調孔隙率湊出答案。~Omitted bank input or excavation can respectively conceal supply or exaggerate natural erosion. When the budget does not close, investigate missing terms rather than adjusting porosity simply to force agreement with surveys.
units.misconception: 平均床高下降量必然等於每個位置的實際沖刷深度~Mean bed lowering necessarily equals the actual scour depth at every location
units.practice: 保持總固體虧損不變，假設侵蝕只集中在四分之一面積，計算該區平均下切。說明控制體平均與局部最大值的差別，並安排能辨認集中侵蝕的測線。~Keep total solid deficit fixed but concentrate erosion over one quarter of the area. Calculate local mean lowering, distinguish it from the whole-reach mean and local maximum, and place transects to detect concentration.

units.anchor: 塊石浸水重量~Submerged weight of loose rock
units.title: 塊石浸水重量~Submerged weight of loose rock
units.mechanism: 塊石抗移動的一部分來自浸水重量，水下浮力會減少可提供的法向力，但拖曳、升力與支點位置才共同決定滑動或翻滾。球形假設便於建立體積尺度，真實塊石的角狀、扁平與互鎖不能由同一粒徑完全描述。較重也不保證穩定，因為大尺寸可能同時增加迎流面積。分析應先畫自由體圖，再決定需要摩擦、力矩或群體排列試驗，而不是只比較乾重。~Submerged weight contributes to rock resistance, but drag, lift and pivot geometry jointly govern sliding or rolling. A sphere provides a transparent volume scale; angularity, flatness and interlocking of real stones are not captured by one diameter. Greater mass does not automatically mean stability because larger stones also expose more frontal area. Draw the free-body diagram before selecting friction, moment or arrangement tests, and distinguish a weight calculation from a complete stability assessment.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rhos=2650 kg/m3; rhow=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; d=0.6 m; Ws=(rhos-rhow)*g*pi*d^3/6=1830.650022 N。適用邊界：完全浸沒理想球體的重量尺度，未計升力、拖曳或互鎖。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rhos=2650 kg/m3; rhow=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; d=0.6 m; Ws=(rhos-rhow)*g*pi*d^3/6=1830.650022 N. Applicable boundary: Submerged ideal-sphere weight scale, excluding lift, drag and interlocking.
units.verify: 量實際石塊三軸尺寸、乾重與排水體積，檢查等效球假設的偏差。於代表鋪排方式下觀察最先移動的石塊與支點，並記錄它是滑動或翻滾，避免只以平均重量判定整層材料表現。~Measure three axes, dry weight and displaced volume to evaluate the equivalent-sphere approximation. Test representative arrangements and identify the first moving stone and pivot. Record sliding versus rolling rather than judging the entire layer from average weight alone.
units.failure: 扁平石片迎流後可能受升力而翻起，與同重緻密石塊的行為不同。若局部石塊先失去互鎖，後續移動會增加，應檢查鋪排而不只換更重材料。~A flat stone may lift and overturn differently from a compact stone of equal mass. Local loss of interlock can trigger further movement, calling for arrangement checks before simply specifying heavier material.
units.misconception: 只要乾燥重量相同不同形狀石塊就具有相同抗移動能力~Stones with equal dry weight have identical movement resistance regardless of shape
units.practice: 將等效直徑增加百分之十，計算浸水重量增加比例，再比較迎流面積的增加比例。畫出一塊石的可能支點，指出仍缺哪些荷載才能判斷翻滾。~Increase equivalent diameter by ten percent and compare the weight increase with frontal-area growth. Draw a possible pivot for one stone and identify the additional loads required before assessing rolling resistance.

units.anchor: 遷移陡坎的追蹤~Tracking migrating bed steps
units.title: 遷移陡坎的追蹤~Tracking migrating bed steps
units.mechanism: 河床陡坎可能沿河道向上游遷移，把下游擾動傳到支流或基礎附近。重複測量其位置可求期間平均移動速率，但侵蝕通常集中在少數洪水，不能把多年平均當成每日固定速度。里程方向必須先定義，否則正負號容易被解讀相反。調查也需區分同一陡坎移動與新陡坎形成，並配合床質、落差和事件流量辨認過程，避免只把兩個影像點連線外推。~A bed step can migrate upstream and transmit downstream disturbance toward tributaries or foundations. Repeated positions give an interval-average migration rate, but erosion often occurs during a few floods rather than at a constant daily speed. Define chainage direction before interpreting signs. Distinguish movement of the same step from creation of a new one, and combine positions with bed material, drop height and event flows instead of extrapolating a line between two images.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：x0=350 m downstream-chainage; x1=295 m downstream-chainage; dt=5 year; vu=(x0-x1)/dt=11 m/year upstream。適用邊界：相同陡坎之期間平均向上游速率，不是未來事件預測。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: x0=350 m downstream-chainage; x1=295 m downstream-chainage; dt=5 year; vu=(x0-x1)/dt=11 m/year upstream. Applicable boundary: Interval-average upstream rate for the same bed step, not a forecast of future events.
units.verify: 以固定基準重測陡坎頂與底，並用照片及床料辨認是否為同一特徵。將每次洪水後的位置加到時間軸，保留位置誤差；如果只有兩期資料，應明確報告平均值而不畫成已知連續速度。~Resurvey crest and toe from fixed benchmarks and use photographs and bed material to identify the same feature. Add post-flood positions to a timeline with uncertainty. With only two surveys, report an interval mean rather than a known continuous velocity.
units.failure: 不同陡坎被誤配會造成虛假的快速遷移，定位誤差也可能大於真實移動。先核對特徵身分與基準，再討論是否需要額外防護，避免依假速率加碼工程。~Matching different steps creates false rapid migration, while positional error can exceed actual movement. Verify feature identity and survey datum before using the apparent rate to justify additional protective works upstream.
units.misconception: 兩次測量算出的平均速率就是未來每日固定的陡坎速度~The average from two surveys is the fixed daily speed of future step migration
units.practice: 若兩次位置各有兩公尺可能誤差，估算速率的最保守範圍。提出洪水後加測的時間安排，說明新增資料如何區分事件跳躍與穩定緩慢遷移。~Allow two metres of possible error at each position and estimate conservative rate bounds. Plan post-flood surveys and explain how additional observations would distinguish event-driven jumps from steady slow migration.

教學假設：斷面比能的兩種流態；y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m~Teaching assumption: Specific energy and alternate depths; y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m
教學假設：臨界水深與控制斷面；q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; yc=(q^2/g)^(1/3)=0.837371 m~Teaching assumption: Critical depth and control sections; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; yc=(q^2/g)^(1/3)=0.837371 m

教學假設：水躍共軛水深；y1=0.4 m; v1=5 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; y2=0.5*y1*(sqrt(1+8*v1^2/(g*y1))-1)=1.241782 m~Teaching assumption: Conjugate depths of a hydraulic jump; y1=0.4 m; v1=5 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; y2=0.5*y1*(sqrt(1+8*v1^2/(g*y1))-1)=1.241782 m
